parts.label: (a)
parts.answer: The intersection inside/on the circle centre $(4,3)$ radius 2 and on the $\arg(z-2-i)\geq\pi/3$ side of the half-line from $(2,1)$.
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: Show a circle centred at $(4,3)$; a relevant arc is sufficient and dashed coordinate guides are allowed. [B1] Show radius 2, implied by at least two correct points among $(2,3),(6,3),(4,1),(4,5)$; FT a non-origin centre. [B1 FT] Show the point $(2,1)$; a half-line or correct full line extending into the third quadrant implies it. [B1] Show a half-line from the chosen point at angle $\pi/3$, cutting the top of the circle between $x=3$ and $x=5$; FT the printed sign/order variants. [B1 FT] Shade the correct intersection, requiring both a correct circle and correct half-line/full line. [B1] Total: 5.
